He joined Birmingham City's academy at 7, debuted at 16, and transferred to Dortmund for £25m at 17 (most expensive 17-year-old ever). At Real Madrid he won the Champions League and La Liga at 21, finishing third in the 2024 Ballon d'Or. His father managed his career and younger brother Jobe also became a professional footballer.
